title: Shelter In Place
description: Plain-text reference for sheltering in place, starting with which room to use: a sealed room above ground for chemical releases, the basement or center for radiation, and the lowest floor for tornadoes. Covers sealing steps and time limits, hurricanes and storms, Run-Hide-Fight, communication, supplies, when to come out, and special needs.
shortDescription: Right room by threat: chemical up and sealed, radiation down, tornado lowest
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
